sources.citation: Kari, Ethelbert E. 2017. Central Delta languages: An overview. Stellenbosch Papers in Linguistics 47: 1-26. doi:10.5774/47-0-213
sources.note: Nothing about stress or accent anywhere in the paper. Abureni is explicitly excluded: p. 3 'Due to a lack of research materials or adequate research materials at the time of writing this paper, Kugbo, Abureni (Mini) and Ochichi are excluded from the discussion in the core areas of linguistics' and fn 6 'There are no data available on Abureni.' Sec. 3.4 Tone (p. 11) says of the family generally, quoting Alex (1989:24), 'all Central Delta lects operate a basic two-tone system' (H, L, downstep), illustrated only from Abuan, Odual and Ogbronuagum.
